about_the_game:
Embark on a quest to defeat Fenrir. Travel distant lands, flanked by your allies, and take your rightful place by Odin's side!


Odin’s Defense is a twist on the traditional Tower Defense genre: instead of upgrades, equip your towers with powerful items to create unique effects each round. Immerse yourself in the story and make choices that will shape the outcome of your campaign.

Hand select the towers you will bring into battle. Get tactical, pick your favourites and charge into battle.

The Spindlewood, Dunes Eternal and the Boolevard of Broken Bones await the arrival of the Bifrost! Journey across forests, graveyards, deserts and more on your quest to defeat Fenrir.

Equip your towers with powerful artefacts for support, power, extra damage and everything in between.

Destroy hoarde after hoarde of enemies in Odin's name! From slimes to gravekeepers, from spiders to mummies, there's no shortage of baddies for you to best.

Features:

- Single player tower defense inspired by Norse mythology.

- Traverse 3+ biomes on your quest to bind Fenrir.

- 15+ available towers all with unique abilities.

- Tons of enemies to challenge your skills and test your wits.

- 12+ items for you to collect and use in creative ways.

- The Longhouse Codex: complete in-game lore and game statistics at your fingertips.

- Play Story Mode to unlock Onslaught Mode.
